title: 메타팩토리 · Zone 운영 분석 (OEE · 파레토 · 관리도 · 산점도)
description: Zone별 OEE·6대 손실·NG 유형·관리도·공정–품질 상관 — 앱 MQTT metafactory/oee/v1 · metafactory/quality/v1

list.name: yvar
list.label: 품질 특성 (y)
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "strings"
schema.fieldKeys(bucket: "raw", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "quality" and r.zone == "${zone}", start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => strings.hasPrefix(v: r._value, prefix: "y_"))

list.name: xvar
list.label: 공정 변수 (x)
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.fieldKeys(bucket: "raw", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "quality" and r.zone == "${zone}", start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => strings.hasPrefix(v: r._value, prefix: "x_"))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "warn" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "act" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "oee" and r.zone == "${zone}" and r._field == "a") |> last()

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "oee" and r.zone == "${zone}" and r._field == "q") |> last()
from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "oee" and r.zone == "${zone}" and r._field == "progress") |> last()

panels.title: OEE · 가동률 · 성능 · 품질 추세 (누적)

targets.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "oee" and r.zone == "${zone}" and (r._field == "oee" or r._field == "a" or r._field == "p" or r._field == "q")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: if r._field == "oee" then "OEE" else if r._field == "a" then "가동률" else if r._field == "p" then "성능" else "품질" })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.description: ISO 22400-2 — OEE = 가동률 × 성능 × 품질 (계획 정비 제외)

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "oee" and r.zone == "${zone}" and r._field =~ /^loss_/) |> last() |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ label: if r._field == "loss_down" then "설비 고장" else if r._field == "loss_setup" then "준비·교체" else if r._field == "loss_stop" then "운영 정지" else if r._field == "loss_idle" then "자재 대기(공전)" else if r._field == "loss_blocked" then "출구 막힘" else if r._field == "loss_speed" then "속도 저하" else if r._field == "loss_defect" then "불량·재작업" else r._field, v: r._value })) |> sort(columns: ["v"], desc: true)
tt = data |> sum(column: "v") |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "v")
total = if length(arr: tt) > 0 then tt[0] else 0.0
data |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with c: r.v })) |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["c"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ label: r.label + " · 누적 " + string(v: int(v: if total > 0.0 then r.c / total * 100.0 + 0.5 else 0.0)) + "%", v: r.v }))

data = from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "quality" and r.zone == "${zone}" and r._field == "ng" and r._value == 1) |> group(columns: ["kind"]) |> count() |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ label: r.kind, v: float(v: r._value) })) |> sort(columns: ["v"], desc: true)
tt = data |> sum(column: "v") |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "v")
total = if length(arr: tt) > 0 then tt[0] else 0.0
data |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with c: r.v })) |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["c"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ label: r.label + " · 누적 " + string(v: int(v: if total > 0.0 then r.c / total * 100.0 + 0.5 else 0.0)) + "%", v: r.v }))

panels.title: 관리도 (I-MR) — ${yvar}

targets.query:
import "math"
data = from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "quality" and r.zone == "${zone}" and r._field == "${yvar}") |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
mr = data |> difference() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: math.abs(x: r._value) })) |> mean() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
cl = data |> mean() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
m = if length(arr: mr) > 0 then mr[0] else 0.0
c = if length(arr: cl) > 0 then cl[0] else 0.0
data |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, value: r._value, ucl: c + 2.66 * m, cl: c, lcl: c - 2.66 * m }))

panels.description: 개별값 관리도 — UCL·LCL = 평균 ± 2.66 × 평균 이동범위 (선택 기간 전체로 계산). 앱 「Zone 대시보드」는 X̄-R(부분군 5)과 Western Electric 규칙 위반도 표시

targets.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "quality" and r.zone == "${zone}" and (r._field == "${xvar}" or r._field == "${yvar}" or r._field == "ng")) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) })) |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["${xvar}"] and exists r["${yvar}"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ 판정: if exists r.ng and r.ng == 1.0 then "NG" else "양품", x: r["${xvar}"], y: r["${yvar}"] })) |> group(columns: ["판정"])
